messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] acceleration graph
parts:
Hi Martinique,

You can use parameter ilevels, which gives you time spent in acceleration ranges in the GGIR part2 csv report.

Next plot all those ranges with a boxplots, where you have time spent per range (bin) on the y-axis and range (bin) on the x-axis.

Vincent
